hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/d/workd/raid-repository}" 2>/dev/null || cd "D:/workd/raid-repository"; { echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] Stop hook fired (cwd=$PWD)"; STATUS=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); AHEAD=$(git rev-list origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$STATUS" ] && [ -n "$AHEAD" ]; then echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] guard passed (ahead=$AHEAD), pushing"; git push origin main 2>&1; echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] push exit=$?"; else echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] guard skipped status_empty=[$([ -z \"$STATUS\" ] && echo yes || echo no)] ahead=[$AHEAD]"; fi; } >> .claude/auto-push.log 2>&1
